stakes.purposeOfTransaction: The reporting person acquired the shares for investment purposes. Based on publicly available information, the reporting person has determined that the Company's current board and management have not delivered acceptable operating or capital structure results and that changes are necessary to protect and enhance shareholder value. The reporting person intents to engage with the Board of Directors regarding the following matters and reserves the right to take any actions it deems appropriate in furtherance of these purposes. Operating performance - The Company has reported continuing losses and a going-concern warning. Cash balances have been low relative to operating cash burn. Revenue growth has not translated into improved profitability or a clear path to sustainable operations. Capital structure and dilution - In August 2026 the Company conducted a warrant inducement in which certain existing warrants were exercised at a temporarily reduced price of $0.795 per share and new warrants were issued at $0.67. The new low priced warrant overhang increases potential dilution and creates additional downward pressure on the stock price. This structure impairs the Company's ability to maintain compliance with Nasdaq listing standards. Repeated optimistic representations that were never realized - Management has repeatedly stated objectives of reaching profitability or cash flow positivity (including targets framed around the of of 2026, even break even by the third quarter of 2026). Actual results have not met these eqxpectations. Governance and accountability - At the August 27, 2026 annual meeting the Board nominated and shareholders elected the same five directors (Anthony Scott, Anthony J. LeVecchio, Katrinka B. McCallum, Gregory K. Wilson, and Dion Hinchcliffe). The election was uncontested. No alternative nominees were advanced. The CEO's employment agreement is set to expire on November 15, 2026.
